theme: ceilings CE-1 operator net scope pins the AI endpoint
text: INTERPRETER, asi-runtime builds only: the AI endpoint pin handed to axon-ai is now (the program's declared @[contained(net: ..)] hosts, or the implicit host api.anthropic.com if none) intersected with AXON_ALLOWED_NET when that variable is set (`*` or unset does not narrow). Before, an unannotated program under AXON_ALLOWED_NET was not pinned and a declared program was pinned to its own hosts only, so an AXON_AI_BASE_URL outside the operator's scope was dialled. A call outside the pin returns the existing catchable Err and sends nothing. The default build (no live AI) has no observable change; no pass/fail of any tracked program changes.
